name: Buzz
summary: Self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms, built on one Nostr relay.
description: A self-hostable workspace where people and AI agents build together: channels, threads, DMs, canvases, media, search and an audit log, all kept as signed events in one Nostr relay. Ships a desktop app (Tauri + React), an agent-first buzz-cli with JSON in/out, and YAML workflows; agents are members with their own keys and channel memberships.
contains: self-hostable Nostr relay workspace where humans and agents share rooms
channels, threads, DMs, canvases, media, search, audit log
agents are members with their own keys and memberships, not bots
desktop app (Tauri + React) for macOS, Linux and Windows
buzz-cli: JSON in / JSON out, plus an ACP harness for Goose, Codex, Claude Code
YAML workflows: message, reaction, schedule and webhook triggers
git events via NIP-34 (patches, repo announcements, status)
